map.距收获天数 = ⌈(当前含水量 − 目标含水量) ÷ 日均降水速率⌉；收获日 =: Days to harvest = ceil((current moisture - target moisture) / daily drying rate); harvest day = today + days; GDD progress = accumulated GDD / required GDD x 100%
map.以含水量为主线预测最佳收割窗口：用当前籽粒含水量与该作物的适收含水量之差，除以日: Use moisture as the main line to predict the optimal harvest window: the difference between current grain moisture and the crop suitable moisture, divided by daily natural drying rate, gives days needed and the harvest date. Simultaneously use accumulated GDD versus required to check maturity (GDD met means physiological maturity). Moisture above the upper suitable limit is "not yet mature", within the suitable range is "suitable to harvest", below the lower limit is "too dry, harvest soon".
map.按 GDD 累计达品种成熟阈值预测收割日。: Predict harvest day by accumulated GDD reaching the variety maturity threshold.
map.结合籽粒含水率/糖度等品质指标校准。: Calibrate with quality indicators like grain moisture / Brix.
map.用于避开雨季、锁定最佳成熟度。: Used to avoid rainy season and lock the best maturity.
map.品种成熟需 GDD(基温 0℃) 约 2100℃·d，当前已累计 1950，日均: Variety maturity needs GDD (base 0C) about 2100 C-day; currently 1950, daily effective heat 15, so threshold in about 10 days. If continuous rain is forecast, harvest early at late waxy stage; around 20% moisture machine loss is lowest.
map.为什么不能等完全成熟？: Why not wait for full maturity?
map.完熟后遇雨易穗发芽、落粒，尤其小麦。蜡熟末至完熟初机收损失最小、品质好，『九成熟: After full maturity rain causes ear sprouting and shattering, especially wheat. From late waxy to early full, machine loss is smallest and quality best; "nine-tenths ripe, full harvest" is distilled experience.
map.GDD 预测和看日历冲突听谁的？: When GDD and calendar conflict, which wins?
